Codex review: needs maintainer review before merge. ## What this changes Session-wide Stop now cancels controller-less embedded runs and returns their run identity through the shared cancellation owner. **Example:** Send chat.abort for a session with an active POST /v1/chat/completions request. - **Before:** Stop reports aborted: true with runIds: [], while the HTTP request continues. - **After:** Stop returns the embedded run ID, and the HTTP request ends with 500 "agent run was cancelled". ## Review scores | Measure | Result | What it means | |---|---|---| | **Overall readiness** | 🦞 diamond lobster **(5/6)** | Focused repair with shipped-entry-point evidence and meaningful authority regressions; the previous blocker is fixed. | | **Proof confidence** | 🦞 diamond lobster **(5/6)** | Sufficient (live_output): Supplied real-Gateway output exercises both HTTP endpoints with a held provider request and confirms prompt cancellation, returned run identity, and cleared active state; production-path authority regressions cover forbidden callers, revocation, and the repaired lifecycle drain. | | **Patch quality** | 🦞 diamond lobster **(5/6)** | No actionable review findings were identified. | ## Product **Kind:** Bug fix · **Worth it:** Yes · **Fix scope:** Complete **User problem:** Stop reports success while an OpenAI-compatible HTTP agent request keeps running. **Reason:** Restores an established cancellation contract without adding configuration or a competing runtime owner. ## Merge readiness ✅ **Ready for maintainer review** This PR fixes a current-main cancellation gap, and the latest revision resolves the prior authorization finding; no actionable defects remain in the reviewed diff. **Priority:** P1 **Reviewed head:** `0c52f2a655c35feab6698effe9c59c8e8cc8cd8f` ## Before merge None. ## Findings None.
Agent review details ### How this fits together Gateway Stop handlers authorize the session, select live runtime owners, signal cancellation, and await terminal persistence before responding. ```mermaid flowchart TD A[Operator Stop] --> B[Gateway admission] B --> C[Shared cancellation plan] D[Archive or delete] --> C C --> E[Chat controller] C --> F[Embedded run] F --> G[Lifecycle persistence] ``` ### Technical review Best possible solution: Use the shared cancellation plan with explicit embedded-run opt-in and live authorization through terminal persistence. Do we have a high-confidence way to reproduce the issue? Current-main source shows the missing embedded cancellation path, matching the supplied real-Gateway before/after results; this review ran no target code. Is this the best way to solve the issue? The repair extends the existing cancellation owner, preserves non-opted callers, and retains current authority at signalling and commit boundaries. AGENTS.md: found and applied where relevant. Codex review notes: model internal, reasoning medium; reviewed against [fc7c5047e59a](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/fc7c5047e59a7d7d4ae37b0f8991786d2def1b76). ### Provenance checked - `Embedded session Stop` changes intended behavior with a stated reason (2900026b333d0181fbcd7e54ce503bddbf36f8fb: Selected channel sessions needed cancellation independent of browser-owned controllers.) - `Caller and session fencing` keeps the original intent (da27b336c0e96cce29e8417cb82da863a57380bd: Delayed Stop must retain the original caller and admitted session incarnation.) - `Terminal cancellation persistence` keeps the original intent (bac42185c4750bb72312217d23ceb0c525296701: Acknowledged abort must settle terminal persistence to prevent stranded writers after restart.) - `Archive and delete draining` keeps the original intent (763399522f65bcf3284de50f3acafc3bf520ddbf: Start cancellation under the lifecycle fence and settle drains outside mutation locks.) ### Testing Proof path: shipped entry point. ### Security None. ### Evidence What I checked: - **Current main still needs the fix:** Fetched main delegates embedded cancellation to the sessions.abort callback; ordinary session-wide chat.abort does not supply that callback. ([`src/gateway/server-methods/chat-abort-runtime.ts:427`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/fc7c5047e59a7d7d4ae37b0f8991786d2def1b76/src/gateway/server-methods/chat-abort-runtime.ts#L427), [fc7c5047e59a](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/fc7c5047e59a7d7d4ae37b0f8991786d2def1b76)) - **Prior finding resolved:** The latest commit forwards lifecycle authorization into the shared plan, which carries it into the delayed cancellation commit guard. ([`src/gateway/server-methods/sessions-lifecycle-drain.ts:206`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/0c52f2a655c35feab6698effe9c59c8e8cc8cd8f/src/gateway/server-methods/sessions-lifecycle-drain.ts#L206), [0c52f2a655c3](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/0c52f2a655c35feab6698effe9c59c8e8cc8cd8f)) - **Final-effect authorization coverage:** The production-admission tests cover allowed and forbidden session callers, revocation before signalling, and revocation before persistence; the new drain cases verify unchanged stored state after revocation and successful cancellation with current authority. ([`src/gateway/server-methods/sessions.abort-embedded.test.ts:142`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/0c52f2a655c35feab6698effe9c59c8e8cc8cd8f/src/gateway/server-methods/sessions.abort-embedded.test.ts#L142), [0c52f2a655c3](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/0c52f2a655c35feab6698effe9c59c8e8cc8cd8f)) - **Supplied runtime proof:** The complete REST-read body records before/after runs through a real isolated Gateway for both HTTP endpoints, including a delayed Stop, cancellation responses, and cleared active state; it also records passing authority regressions and mutation controls. ([0c52f2a655c3](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/0c52f2a655c35feab6698effe9c59c8e8cc8cd8f)) - **Related fixes remain distinct:** https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/167995 merged cancellation-error classification and explicitly left operator Stop as follow-up; https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/166753 merged ordinary-command cleanup rather than embedded model cancellation. ([97c7a5e48731](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/97c7a5e487313708964bf6a44242df3e67dac37d)) - **Media inspected:** All prepared images were inspected; they show the separate ordinary-command cleanup repair and are not counted as proof of this PR's HTTP cancellation behavior. Label justifications: - `P1`: Operator Stop currently acknowledges cancellation while an HTTP agent request continues consuming provider work. - `rating: 🦞 diamond lobster`: Overall readiness is 🦞 diamond lobster; proof is 🦞 diamond lobster and patch quality is 🦞 diamond lobster. - `status: 👀 ready for maintainer look`: ClawSweeper has no concrete contributor-facing blocker left for this PR. - `proof: sufficient`: Contributor real behavior proof is sufficient. - `proof: telegram-e2e`: This PR needs Telegram Test Server proof with the repository E2E skill. Session-wide chat.abort can now stop controller-less channel replies, which a Telegram Test Server userbot can observe. ### Rating scale 6/6 🦀 challenger crab · 5/6 🦞 diamond lobster · 4/6 🐚 platinum hermit · 3/6 🦐 gold shrimp · 2/6 🦪 silver shellfish · 1/6 🧂 unranked krab.
